fallen_empires_awakening.11.en: Reachable only via a test event

notes.zh: 前提是另一篇“沉睡者苏醒”：第一个堕落帝国苏醒（fallen_empire_awakening_events.txt:113）并把另一堕落帝国标为宿敌（L198/219）。宿敌在约10年计时内平均5年苏醒（war_in_heaven.1，隐藏）。
notes.en: It requires Sleepers Awake: a first Fallen Empire awakens (fallen_empire_awakening_events.txt:113) and marks another as its ancient rival (L198/219). The rival awakens with MTTH 5 years within a 10-year timer (hidden war_in_heaven.1).

notes.zh: 选项取决于思潮与邻接关系：投靠先苏醒者、投靠宿敌（会成为其附庸）、保持中立，或已是附庸者随宗主参战。
notes.en: Options depend on ethics and borders: side with the first sleeper, side with the rival (becoming its subject), stay neutral, or follow your overlord if already a subject.

notes.zh: 此篇在本故事中只能经测试事件 war_in_heaven.1000（is_test_event，触发条件 always = no）到达，实际游戏中不属于天堂之战，而属于蜂巢堕落帝国苏醒。
notes.en: Within this story it is reachable only through the test event war_in_heaven.1000 (is_test_event, trigger always = no); in play it belongs to the hive Fallen Empire awakening, not to the War in Heaven.

scope.zh: 完整核对 war_in_heaven_events.txt 全部事件、战争目标结局与观察者副本；前置的“沉睡者苏醒”属另一篇故事。
scope.en: Checked every event in war_in_heaven_events.txt, the war-goal endings and observer copies; the preceding Sleepers Awake is a separate story.

uncertain: observer.77/78 (observer copies of war_in_heaven.5/6) form another reviewer's story (event-observer-77, fired by the war goal container) and are not linked here.
League membership exchanges (14/15/19/20/21/22) follow from accepting leadership; their AI-driven timing is not modelled.
fallen_empires_awakening.11 remains a secondary entry only because test event war_in_heaven.1000 (L11-72) calls fallen_empires_awakening.10; requested a compiler rule to ignore is_test_event records.
